items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: You know, Billy Taylor, Max Roach, Billy Higgins, Jackie McLean, Abdullah Ibrahim. All those guys that I spent time with that had a big influence on me

ctx.x: Oh very much so. Very much so. And I do believe, I always tell a lot of my students for this music to be approached right and properly you really have to be. I think the majority of those guys who played the music that I knew were. Those guys that I named to you

that I was close with or I worked with were. A lot of times they may not have worn it on their sleeves, but if you got to know them, okay, how they conducted themselves, you knew that there was something underlying in there that was intact. You know, Billy Taylor, Max Roach, Billy Higgins, Jackie McLean, Abdullah Ibrahim. All those guys that I spent time with that had a big influence on me, you know Betty, you knew that there was some things intact. And it had to be for them to be the kind of people that they…
The Joe Wilders of the world.
